notes: Bootstrap instance seeded by Evan Wave 5B-2 (2026-04-19) from the HY-IG v2 reference pair and the Tournament Design Parameters signal enumeration. Closes §1.2 of docs/validation-audit-20260419-evan.md (signal-code naming drift). Append-only: later waves extend this list as new pairs introduce new signals. Never reorder or delete existing entries.

signals.description: Posterior probability of the stress regime from a 2-state Gaussian Hidden Markov Model fit on the indicator series. Values in [0, 1]; higher = more stressed. Regime label 'stress' is assigned by pre-whitened variance ranking (larger-variance state = stress) per META-D2 sanity check.
signals.notes: Sign convention: stress = high. Direction is countercyclical for risk-off targets (SPY, equities). Validated against GFC / COVID episodes (stress_prob > 0.7 during both).

signals.description: Maximum a-posteriori regime label from a 3-state Gaussian Hidden Markov Model (expansion / transition / contraction). Integer-valued in {0, 1, 2}; labels assigned by variance ranking (lowest variance = expansion, highest = contraction).
signals.notes: Discrete state index, NOT a probability. Tournament strategies typically condition on mode==0 (expansion) vs mode==2 (contraction); transition state (mode==1) is often pooled with expansion for P1 / P2 strategy families.

signals.description: Smoothed probability of the high-variance (stress) regime from a 2-state Markov-switching regression with regime-dependent intercept and variance. Values in [0, 1]; higher = more stressed.
signals.notes: Distinct from hmm_stress: Markov-switching fits a regression (with covariates) rather than a marginal Gaussian mixture. Regime labeling follows the same variance-ranking convention as hmm_stress.

signals.description: One-month percent change in C&I loans outstanding (FRED BUSLOANS, $bn SA). Used countercyclically by the busloans_spy tournament winner: long the target only when MoM loan growth is in the bottom quartile of its trailing rolling window.
signals.notes: BUSLOANS is a Conference Board LAGGING index component; this rate-of-change transform is a countercyclical/defensive trigger, not a forward-causal signal (Toda-Yamamoto forward direction n.s. at all lags).

signals.description: Three-month percent change in EIA WTTSTUS1 petroleum stocks. Used for petrol_inv_spy as a stationary inventory-cycle momentum signal; higher values mean faster inventory builds.
signals.notes: WTTSTUS1 is sourced from project Data Master.xlsx sheet WTTSTUS1 because the public FRED API rejected the series on 2026-06-17. Direction is empirical/mixed; petroleum stock builds can reflect weak demand or supply shocks.

signals.description: Headline ISM Services PMI diffusion index level from the project Data Master workbook. Values above 50 indicate services expansion; lower values indicate slower activity or contraction.
signals.notes: ISM Services PMI is not available through public FRED as of 2026-06-18; source is Data Master.xlsx sheet ISM PMI, column CDis, CSta - ISM Services PMI.

signals.description: ISM Services PMI minus the 50 expansion/contraction threshold. Positive values indicate expansion; negative values indicate contraction.
signals.notes: Designed to preserve the economically meaningful 50 threshold in strategy tests.

signals.description: One-month change in ISM Services PMI, in index points. Higher values indicate improving services momentum.
signals.notes: Stationary momentum transform supplied by Dana.

signals.description: Three-month change in ISM Services PMI, in index points. Higher values indicate improving services momentum over a quarter.
signals.notes: Included explicitly because the brief flagged level-versus-momentum distinctions as economically important.

signals.description: Six-month change in ISM Services PMI, in index points. Higher values indicate improving services momentum over two quarters.
signals.notes: Longer-horizon momentum transform supplied by Dana.

signals.description: Rolling 60-month z-score of ISM Services PMI level. Higher values indicate the PMI is elevated relative to its own recent history.
signals.notes: Lookback-based normalization for the bounded diffusion index.

signals.description: Binary flag equal to 1 when ISM Services PMI is above 50 and 0 otherwise.
signals.notes: Direct encoding of the expansion/contraction threshold.

signals.description: Month-on-month change in M2 YoY growth (acceleration, pp).
signals.notes: Money-supply growth transform; tested both procyclical and countercyclical in the tournament.

signals.description: 6-month (126 trading day) percent momentum of the SOX/SPY price ratio. Relative-strength transform that partials out common market beta; higher = semiconductors outperforming the broad market over the trailing 6 months.
signals.notes: Procyclical orientation for SPY. Used as the winning intermarket signal for phlxsox_spy (L63, long/cash). Stationary per Dana 20260619 tests; the raw sox_spy_ratio level is NON-stationary and excluded as a signal.
